-- Cleanup previous instance if re-executed
local globalEnv = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G :: any
if globalEnv.DevAssetProfilerCleanup then
	pcall(globalEnv.DevAssetProfilerCleanup)
end

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	Players:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Wait()
	LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
end

-- Weak table to track instances without memory leaks or GetFullName() collisions
if not globalEnv.TrackerLoadedInstances then
	globalEnv.TrackerLoadedInstances = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
end
local seenInstances: {[Instance]: boolean} = globalEnv.TrackerLoadedInstances

local connections: {RBXScriptConnection} = {}
local function bind(signal: RBXScriptSignal, fn: (...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
	local conn = signal:Connect(fn)
	table.insert(connections, conn)
	return conn
end

	SuccessBg   = Color3.fromRGB(20, 38, 28),
	Danger      = Color3.fromRGB(248, 113, 113),
}

local function create(className: string, props: {[string]: any}?): any
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	if props then
		local parent = props.Parent
		for k, v in pairs(props) do
			if k ~= "Parent" then
				(inst :: any)[k] = v
			end
		end
		if parent then
			inst.Parent = parent
		end
	end
	return inst
end

local function corner(parent: Instance, radius: number): UICorner
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function stroke(parent: Instance, color: Color3, thickness: number?): UIStroke
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Parent = parent
	return s
end

local function getGuiRoot(): Instance
	local ok, target = pcall(function()
		return (typeof(gethui) == "function" and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
	end)
	if ok and target then
		local canParent = pcall(function()
			local t = Instance.new("Folder")
			t.Parent = target
			t:Destroy()
		end)
		if canParent then return target end
	end
	return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local function extractContentIds(inst: Instance): {string}
	local props = ASSET_PROPS[inst.ClassName]
	if not props then return {} end
	local list = {}
	for _, prop in ipairs(props) do
		local ok, val = pcall(function() return (inst :: any)[prop] end)
		if ok and typeof(val) == "string" and val ~= "" then
			table.insert(list, val)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function retrySingleAsset(errRecord: FailedRecord, actionBtn: TextButton?, cardFrame: Frame?)
	if actionBtn then
		actionBtn.Text = "..."
		actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.TextMuted
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local startTime = os.clock()
		local targetToLoad: {any} = {}

		if errRecord.targetInstance and errRecord.targetInstance.Parent then
			table.insert(targetToLoad, errRecord.targetInstance)
		elseif errRecord.contentId ~= "" then
			table.insert(targetToLoad, errRecord.contentId)
		end

		local retrySucceeded = false
		local latestStatus = "Unknown"

		if #targetToLoad > 0 then
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(targetToLoad, function(loadedId, status)
				if loadedId == errRecord.contentId or errRecord.contentId == "" then
					latestStatus = tostring(status)
					if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
						retrySucceeded = true
					end
				end
			end)
		else
			latestStatus = "Instance destroyed"
		end

		local elapsedMs = math.floor((os.clock() - startTime) * 1000)

		if retrySucceeded then
			if actionBtn then
				actionBtn.Text = string.format("OK %dms", elapsedMs)
				actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Success
			end
			if cardFrame then
				cardFrame.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.SuccessBg
				local s = cardFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
				if s then
					s.Color = THEME.Success
				end
			end

			task.delay(1.2, function()
				for i, item in ipairs(state.failed) do
					if item == errRecord or item.id == errRecord.id then
						table.remove(state.failed, i)
						break
					end
				end
				for i, item in ipairs(filteredErrors) do
					if item == errRecord or item.id == errRecord.id then
						table.remove(filteredErrors, i)
						break
					end
				end
				state.failedSeen[errRecord.id] = nil
				state.recoveredCount += 1
				updateUI()

				if state.activeTab == "errors" then
					if cardFrame and cardFrame.Parent then
						cardFrame:Destroy()
					end
					if #filteredErrors == 0 then
						renderErrors(SearchInput.Text)
					end
				elseif state.activeTab == "info" then
					switchTab("errors")
				end
			end)
		else
			errRecord.retries += 1
			errRecord.reason = string.format("%s (attempt %d)", latestStatus, errRecord.retries + 1)
			if actionBtn then
				actionBtn.Text = "Fail"
				actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Danger
				task.delay(1.4, function()
					actionBtn.Text = "Retry"
					actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Accent
				end)
			end
			if state.activeTab == "info" and currentRecord == errRecord then
				DiagStatus.Text = errRecord.reason
			end
			updateUI()
		end
	end)
end

local function renderNextErrorChunk()
	if renderedErrorCount >= #filteredErrors then
		if loadMoreBtn then
			loadMoreBtn:Destroy()
			loadMoreBtn = nil
		end
		return
	end

	local nextLimit = math.min(#filteredErrors, renderedErrorCount + CONFIG.ErrorPageSize)
	for idx = renderedErrorCount + 1, nextLimit do
		createErrorCard(filteredErrors[idx], idx)
	end
	renderedErrorCount = nextLimit

	local remaining = #filteredErrors - renderedErrorCount

			state.speed = speed
			ChipSpeed.Text = string.format("%.0f/s", speed)

			local eta = (speed > 0) and math.ceil(remain / speed) or 0
			ChipEta.Text = (eta > 0 and eta < 999) and string.format("ETA %ds", eta) or "ETA --"
		end
	end
end)

-- O(1) Pointer Queue + Concurrent Worker Pool
local assetQueue: {Instance} = {}
local queueHead = 1
local queueTail = 0

local function processBatch(batch: {Instance})
	if #batch == 0 then return end
	local leader = batch[1]
	if leader and leader.Parent then
		CurrentPath.Text = formatPath(leader)
		CurrentMeta.Text = string.format(
			"Class: %s | Workers: %d/%d | Files: %d",
			getAssetType(leader),
			state.activeWorkers,
			CONFIG.MaxWorkers,
			state.totalFiles
		)
	end

	local uriToInstance: {[string]: Instance} = {}
	for _, inst in ipairs(batch) do
		for _, uri in ipairs(extractContentIds(inst)) do
			if not uriToInstance[uri] then
				uriToInstance[uri] = inst
			end
		end
	end

	ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(batch, function(contentId, fetchStatus)
		state.totalFiles += 1
		if fetchStatus ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
			local idKey = tostring(contentId)
			if not state.failedSeen[idKey] then
				state.failedSeen[idKey] = true
				local finalInst = uriToInstance[idKey] or leader

				table.insert(state.failed, {
					id = idKey,
					name = finalInst and finalInst.Name or idKey,
					fullName = finalInst and finalInst:GetFullName() or idKey,
					assetType = finalInst and getAssetType(finalInst) or "Asset",
					contentId = idKey,
					targetInstance = finalInst,
					reason = tostring(fetchStatus),
					retries = 0,
				})
			end
		end
	end)

	state.processedInstances += #batch
	updateUI()
end

local function spawnWorkers()
	if not state.isRunning and queueHead <= queueTail then
		state.isRunning = true
		state.activeStartTime = os.clock()
	end

	while state.activeWorkers < CONFIG.MaxWorkers and queueHead <= queueTail do
		state.activeWorkers += 1

		task.spawn(function()
			while queueHead <= queueTail do
				local batch: {Instance} = {}
				local count = math.min(CONFIG.BatchSize, queueTail - queueHead + 1)
				for _ = 1, count do
					local item = assetQueue[queueHead]
					assetQueue[queueHead] = nil :: any
					queueHead += 1
					if item then
						table.insert(batch, item)
					end
				end

				if #batch > 0 then
					processBatch(batch)
				end
				task.wait()
			end

			state.activeWorkers -= 1

			if state.activeWorkers == 0 and queueHead > queueTail then
				queueHead = 1
				queueTail = 0

				if state.processedInstances >= state.totalInstances and not state.isComplete then
					state.accumulatedTime += (os.clock() - state.activeStartTime)
					state.elapsedTime = state.accumulatedTime
					state.isComplete = true
					state.isRunning = false

					StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = (#state.failed > 0) and THEME.Danger or THEME.Success
					CurrentPath.Text = "ALL ASSETS VERIFIED"
					CurrentMeta.Text = string.format(
						"Done in %s (%d files, %d failed)",
						formatClock(state.elapsedTime),
						state.totalFiles,
						#state.failed
					)
					ChipEta.Text = "DONE"
					updateUI()
					if state.activeTab == "errors" then
						renderErrors(SearchInput.Text)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function enqueue(items: {Instance})
	if queueHead > queueTail then
		queueHead = 1
		queueTail = 0
	end

	local added = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		if not seenInstances[item] then
			seenInstances[item] = true
			if #extractContentIds(item) > 0 then
				queueTail += 1
				assetQueue[queueTail] = item
				added += 1
			end
		end
	end

	if added > 0 then
		state.totalInstances += added
		state.isComplete = false
		StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Accent
		updateUI()
		spawnWorkers()
	end
end

local pendingStream: {Instance} = {}
local streamDebounce: thread? = nil

local function onDescendant(inst: Instance)
	if isTrackable(inst) then
		table.insert(pendingStream, inst)
		if not streamDebounce then
			streamDebounce = task.delay(1.2, function()
				local toAdd = pendingStream
				pendingStream = {}
				streamDebounce = nil
				enqueue(toAdd)
			end)
		end
	end
end

bind(workspace.DescendantAdded, onDescendant)
bind(ReplicatedStorage.DescendantAdded, onDescendant)

local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
if pGui then
	bind(pGui.DescendantAdded, onDescendant)
end

local function bootstrap()
	CurrentPath.Text = "INDEXING DOMAIN ROOTS..."

	local roots: {Instance?} = {
		workspace, ReplicatedStorage, ReplicatedFirst, Lighting,
		MaterialService, SoundService, StarterPack, pGui
	}

	local found: {Instance} = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
		if r then
			for _, d in ipairs(r:GetDescendants()) do
				if isTrackable(d) then
					table.insert(found, d)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	enqueue(found)

	if state.totalInstances == 0 then
		state.isComplete = true
		state.isRunning = false
		StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Success
		CurrentPath.Text = "NO ASSETS TO LOAD"
		CurrentMeta.Text = "0 items in memory"
		updateUI()
	end
end

-- [[ CONFIGURATION ]]
local TOGGLE_KEY        = Enum.KeyCode.V
local PANIC_KEY         = Enum.KeyCode.End
local AUTO_OFF_MINUTES  = 10

-- [[ CORE SERVICES ]]
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService  = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui          = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player    = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
local uniqueTag = "TrueRightClickUnlocker_v105"
local bindName  = "MouseUnlockerPriorityLoop_v105"

-- [[ 1. MEMORY & TELEPORT CLEANUP ]]
local function globalCleanup()
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
    for _, obj in pairs(CoreGui:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:GetAttribute(uniqueTag) or obj.Name == "InternalMouseControlMax" then 
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) 
        end
    end
    if playerGui then
        for _, obj in pairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:GetAttribute(uniqueTag) or obj.Name == "InternalMouseControlMax" then 
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) 
            end
        end
    end
end
globalCleanup() 

-- [[ 2. UI CONTAINER ]]
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "InternalMouseControlMax"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screenGui:SetAttribute(uniqueTag, true)

local parentSuccess = pcall(function() screenGui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not parentSuccess and playerGui then screenGui.Parent = playerGui end

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "MaxOverride"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toggleBtn.Text = ""
toggleBtn.Modal = false 
toggleBtn.Parent = screenGui

-- [[ 3. SMART CAMERA & SHIFT-LOCK PROFILER ]]
local function isFirstPerson()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return false end
    
    if player.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then return true end
    
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return false end

    local trackingPart = char:FindFirstChild("Head") 
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") 
        or char.PrimaryPart
        
    if trackingPart then
        local distance = (cam.CFrame.Position - trackingPart.Position).Magnitude
        return distance <= 2.2
    end

    return false
end

-- [[ 4. PRIORITY RENDER LOOP ]]
local rightMouseDown = false
local startTime = os.time()

local function priorityFrameUpdate()
    if (os.time() - startTime) >= (AUTO_OFF_MINUTES * 60) then
        toggleBtn.Modal = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        return
    end

    if toggleBtn.Modal and not isFirstPerson() then
        toggleBtn.Modal = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        return
    end

    if toggleBtn.Modal then
        if rightMouseDown then
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        else
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        end
    end
end

-- [[ 5. HARDENED EVENT LISTENERS ]]
local connections = {}

local function terminateSystem()
    toggleBtn.Modal = false
    globalCleanup()
    for _, conn in pairs(connections) do
        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
    end
    table.clear(connections)
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
end

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if input.KeyCode == TOGGLE_KEY then
        if not isFirstPerson() then return end
        
        toggleBtn.Modal = not toggleBtn.Modal
        if toggleBtn.Modal then
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            startTime = os.time() 
            RunService:BindToRenderStep(bindName, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, priorityFrameUpdate)
        else
            pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        end
    elseif input.KeyCode == PANIC_KEY then
        terminateSystem()
    end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        rightMouseDown = true
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        rightMouseDown = false
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
    rightMouseDown = false
end))

    end)

    end
    if rec.state == "pending" then
        p[#p + 1] = "waiting for response..."
    elseif rec.state == "blocked" then
        p[#p + 1] = "Blocked"
    elseif rec.state == "error" then
        p[#p + 1] = "Error: " .. clip(rec.err or "?", 160)
    elseif rec.count then
        p[#p + 1] = "Returned " .. fmtNum(rec.count) .. (rec.count == 1 and " object" or " objects")
    elseif rec.body then
        p[#p + 1] = #rec.body == 0 and "Empty response" or ("Response: " .. fmtNum(#rec.body) .. " characters")
    elseif rec.note then
        p[#p + 1] = rec.note
    end
    if rec.sent then p[#p + 1] = "Sent: " .. fmtNum(#rec.sent) .. " characters" end
    if rec.dt and (rec.state == "done" or rec.state == "error") then p[#p + 1] = fmtTime(rec.dt) end
    return table.concat(p, "  |  ")
end

local WATCH = {
    HttpGet = "GET", HttpGetAsync = "GET",
    HttpPost = "POST", HttpPostAsync = "POST",
    GetObjects = "OBJ",
}
local HookedSet = {}

local function wrapFor(target, fn)
    if iscclosure and not iscclosure(target) then return fn end
    return newcc(fn)
end

local function handleGameCall(method, invoke, ...)
    local kind = WATCH[method]
    local url = tostring((...))
    local source = "game:" .. method

    if isBlocked(url) then
        if State.enabled then finishRecord(newRecord(kind, source, url), { state = "blocked" }) end
        if kind == "OBJ" then return {} end
        return ""
    end
    if not State.enabled then return invoke(...) end

    local rec = newRecord(kind, source, url)
    if kind == "POST" then
        local data, ctype = select(2, ...)
        if data ~= nil then rec.sent = tostring(data) end
        rec.request = { Url = url, Data = data, ContentType = ctype }
    end

    local res = guarded(invoke, ...)
    if not res[1] then
        finishRecord(rec, { state = "error", err = tostring(res[2]) })
        error(res[2], 0)
    end

    local out = res[2]
    if kind == "OBJ" then
        local names = {}
        if type(out) == "table" then
            for i, o in ipairs(out) do
                names[i] = typeof(o) == "Instance" and (o.ClassName .. "  " .. o.Name) or tostring(o)
            end
        end
        finishRecord(rec, { state = "done", count = #names, copyText = table.concat(names, "\n") })
    else
        finishRecord(rec, { state = "done", body = out == nil and "" or tostring(out) })
    end
    task.defer(fireOnRequest, { Url = url, Method = method })
    return table.unpack(res, 2, res.n)
end

local function handleRequest(old, req)
    if State.unloaded or type(req) ~= "table" or busy[coroutine.running()] then
        return old(req)
    end

    local url = tostring(req.Url)
    local method = string.upper(tostring(req.Method or "GET"))
    local snapshot = deepCopy(req)

    if isBlocked(url) then
        if State.enabled then
            local r = newRecord(method, "request", url)
            r.request = snapshot
            finishRecord(r, { state = "blocked" })
        end
        return { Success = false, StatusCode = 403, StatusMessage = "Blocked by HttpSpy", Headers = {}, Body = "" }
    end

    local send = req
    local host = string.match(url, "^https?://([^/:]+)")
    if host and Proxies[host] then
        send = {}
        for k, v in pairs(req) do send[k] = v end
        local s, e = string.find(url, host, 1, true)
        send.Url = string.sub(url, 1, s - 1) .. Proxies[host] .. string.sub(url, e + 1)
    end

    local rec
    if State.enabled then
        rec = newRecord(method, "request", url)
        rec.request = snapshot
        if type(req.Body) == "string" and #req.Body > 0 then rec.sent = req.Body end
        task.defer(fireOnRequest, snapshot)
    end

    local res = guarded(old, send)
    if not res[1] then
        if rec then finishRecord(rec, { state = "error", err = tostring(res[2]) }) end
        error(res[2], 0)
    end

    local response = res[2]
    local hook = ResponseHooks[url]
    if hook then
        local ok, r = pcall(hook, response)
        if ok and r ~= nil then response = r end
    end

    if rec then
        local f = { state = "done" }
        if type(response) == "table" then
            f.statusCode = response.StatusCode
            f.statusMsg = response.StatusMessage
            f.body = response.Body == nil and "" or tostring(response.Body)
        else
            f.body = tostring(response)
        end
        finishRecord(rec, f)
    end
    return response
end

if hookmetamethod or getrawmetatable then

    local hookFn = newcc(function(self, ...)

                return handleGameCall(method, function(...)
                    if setnamecallmethod then setnamecallmethod(method) end

            oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
            if setreadonly then setreadonly(mt, false) elseif make_writeable then make_writeable(mt) end
            mt.__namecall = hookFn

                    local res = guarded(old, ...)
                    if not res[1] then
                        finishRecord(rec, { state = "error", err = tostring(res[2]) })
                        error(res[2], 0)
                    end
                    finishRecord(rec, { state = "done", note = "Connected" })
                    return table.unpack(res, 2, res.n)
                end))
            end)
            if hooked then w += 1 end
        end
    end

else

end
